text_block_list.text:
One day, I come across a classroom
packed wall
to wall with teachers.
Curious, I peek inside...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...to find Голд Шипп right in the middle of
them!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let me off the hook already! Isn't
this long
enough for an apology?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
After covering your homeroom teacher
in chalk
powder?! I think not!
text_block_list.name: Teacher

text_block_list.text:
I was just testing its flight range! It's not
my fault
someone walked in at a bad
time!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Very well. Seeing as you clearly feel no
remorse
for your actions, we'll just have
to up the page
count!
text_block_list.name: Teacher

text_block_list.text:
This one's on Голд Шип. It takes her a
while to
cheer up after that...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
